SEN-TX.name: James Talarico
SEN-TX.evidence: Campaign centred on attacking 'billionaire megadonors' and a system 'rigged' by them, 'top vs. bottom' framing, working-class economic agenda (minimum wage, union strength, medical debt). Reporter calls him progressive but no JD/DSA/M4A/Sanders markers; stresses bridging divides.

TN-8.name: Heidi Kuhn
TN-8.evidence: Shelby County Criminal Court Clerk (elected official); launch focused on gas prices/cost of living; listed priorities Epstein files release and prescription drug costs. No left or centrist markers found.

MT-1.name: Sam Forstag
MT-1.evidence: Smokejumper/union leader running on working-class identity; 'done pretending the rich and powerful are going to take care of us'; AOC rally, Sanders endorsement (per search snippets), corporate-money ban. No M4A/JD/DSA marker so liberal not left; also DCCC Red to Blue and Tester/Bullock backing.

GA-2.name: Sanford Bishop
GA-2.evidence: Long-serving incumbent (since 1993), senior Blue Dog Coalition member with a more conservative record than most CBC members (Cook Political snippet via search; Cook page 403). AJC 2026 piece fetched calls him 'longtime Democrat' but no ideology label.

OH-3.name: Joyce Beatty
OH-3.evidence: Multi-term incumbent in safe D+21 seat, former CBC chair, conventional party-line Democrat; no left (JD/DSA) or centrist markers. Based on prior knowledge plus search snippets; no supporting page fetched.

WI-3.name: Rebecca Cooke
WI-3.evidence: Blue Dog PAC endorsement (its first 2026 challenger): 'working-class American who proudly waits tables at night', dairy-farm roots, cross-party appeal to Trump voters; also New Dem backing and DCCC Red to Blue. Blue Dog page is undated (2026 copyright).

TX-38.name: Melissa McDonough
TX-38.evidence: Campaign site: 'We have more in common than what divides us', anti-extremism framing; lists Medicare for All and abortion rights; endorsements from Texas AFL-CIO, Houston Chronicle, Stonewall Dems, Progressive Voters Network. M4A without Sanders/OR/WFP backing -> liberal. Site is current, undated.

SEN-AR.name: Hallie Shoffner
SEN-AR.evidence: Sixth-generation farmer who lost family farm; keeps 'the national party' at arm's length, critics call her a 'DINO' with 'MAGA vibes'; says corporate lobbyists have a 'stranglehold' on farm policy, 'economic dignity for folks who feel left behind'. No explicit 'moderate' self-label.

GA-11.name: Chris Harden
GA-11.evidence: Self-described 'a moderate Democrat focused on results, not rhetoric'; attorney; 'restoring common sense and stability in government', 'not running to add to the noise'.

AL-1.name: Clyde Jones
AL-1.evidence: 21-year Army veteran, former Alabama Arise board president; grassroots, 'not taking PAC money', accountable to voters not special interests, ethics/anti-corruption reform (stock-trading ban); supports Medicaid expansion, minimum wage hike. No left or centrist markers.

GOV-KS.name: Cindy Holscher
GOV-KS.evidence: State senator; beat Gov. Kelly-endorsed Ethan Corson in primary; frames race as families vs 'corporate elites and lobbyists', stadium 'giveaway', working-class roots; but conventional legislator stressing bipartisan record, abortion rights, Medicaid expansion; rejects 'socialist' label.

VA-5.name: Tom Perriello
VA-5.evidence: Former congressman with 'progressive populist' reputation; 2026 theme 'getting down prices, getting wages up', common-ground language, defends ACA vote; DCCC Red to Blue. No explicit anti-corporate/outsider or left/centrist markers in fetched sources.

OH-1.name: Greg Landsman
OH-1.evidence: Incumbent in toss-up seat; campaign stresses local ties, constituent service and record; End Citizens United and DMFI endorsements; no explicit centrist/Problem Solvers branding found in fetched sources (New Dem membership from memory, insufficient alone).
